title: Eden system-design document
description: Tier-A architecture document (doc 11 §6): the cell-typed component decomposition of the system plus its environments x substrate deployment plan (the P6 axes). Registry form (.yaml), wholly structured; prose fields are markdown strings. Extends the common envelope; every component must carry >=1 upstream `realizes` edge into tier P or the domain-model (traceability rule T3).

type.description: Discriminator: selects this schema. Must be the literal string `system-design`.

data.description: Structured body of the system-design document: the component decomposition and the deployment plan.

components.description: The cell-typed component decomposition of the system. List every component that exists at the architecture tier; each gets a stable CMP id, names its cell, declares its intra-system dependencies and its external connector usage, and links upstream to the product/domain items it serves.

id.description: Stable component identifier, form CMP-NNNN (e.g. CMP-0003). Unique within this document; the join key other documents cite.

name.description: Short human-readable component name (e.g. `intake-service`, `project-dashboard`). Lower-kebab or plain words; one component, one name.

responsibility.description: Markdown statement of the single responsibility this component owns: what it is accountable for and, by omission, what it is not. Keep it to one cohesive duty (a component with two responsibilities is two components).

cell.description: The cell (typed software category) this component is built as. v1 cells (doc 02 §2): `go-backend` for server-side Go components, `svelte-ui` for Svelte front-end components. The cell selects the 10-phase spine, template, and gate the build runs under.

depends_on.description: Intra-system dependencies: the CMP ids of other components this one depends on. References must resolve within this document's `components` list (no dangling refs, T1). Declare the call/data direction this component initiates; do not list the reverse (derived by tooling).

connectors.description: The connector families this component reaches the outside world through (doc 05). Each entry is a family id `F1`-`F6` (F1 infrastructure/substrate, F2 SCM, F3 billing, F4 agents, F5 observability, F6 design systems) or the literal `adapter` for a specific per-provider adapter binding. Nothing else touches the outside world (P1/E1).

links.description: Typed upstream edges for this component (doc 11 §3). Every component SHALL carry >=1 `realizes` edge into a tier-P item (REQ/WF/PER) or a domain-model item (ENT/INV) it serves (T3 — no unmotivated architecture). Links point upstream only (T2); reverse edges are derived, never written.

environments_plan.description: The deployment plan across the P6 axes: which environments exist and what infrastructure substrate (F1 adapter) each runs on.

environments.description: The environments this system is deployed into, drawn from the standard ladder `development` -> `test` -> `staging` -> `production`. List only the environments the project actually uses; each one listed SHALL have an entry in `substrate_map`.

items.description: One environment from the standard ladder.

substrate_map.description: Maps each environment to the infrastructure substrate (F1 adapter, doc 05) it provisions onto. Keys are environment names; every environment listed in `environments` SHOULD appear here. Substrate values: `docker-compose`, `kubernetes`, `bare-host`, `vm`.

^(development|test|staging|production)$.description: The F1 infrastructure substrate this environment runs on: `docker-compose` (local/compose), `kubernetes` (kind or managed), `bare-host` (a provisioned host), or `vm` (Firecracker/KubeVirt-class virtual machine).
